provenance: ORIGINAL. The live demo's cast is an original community (Brendan's rulings of 2026-10-01, decision 0491): these names, interests, evening pastimes and lines were written for the demo and are not taken from the books (docs/setting_bible.md 3.2: original game design is labelled original). They are hand-written for these nine demo residents only; the main game's fixed 32-entry name catalogs and naming system (docs/game_gdd.md 5.3) are unchanged. Rowan stays the settlement game's Warden; the mouse keeper here is not Rowan.
note: One row per demo cast key (demo/demo_manifest.gd). name: the resident's name (personal + descriptive, DEC-016). interest: their own pastime, a personal trait, never a species one. speech: how they talk (DEC-017: distinct voices, light dialect). evening: what they do when free of an evening, as it follows 'is ...' (no pronouns). pleased: a short line, in their own voice, said ONLY on an evening after a deed of theirs the ledger committed that day. dialect: their own light dialect words (DEC-017), at most two words a line, appended to their own spoken lines only; functional UI text never carries them. Edit freely: the demo reads this file at boot.
